card.title: Steam Deck - Replace shoulder switch R1/L1

source.title: Steam Deck - Replace shoulder switch R1/L1

claims.statement: Steam Deck LCD shoulder switches break off easily; replacements are sold as Steam Deck or Xbox 360 Bluetooth pair switches. A preheater helps as the board sinks heat.
Outer switch pins are ground; if the middle pad rips, wire it to the L1/R1 test point on the back of the controller board (location varies by rev. B/F/G).

procedure: If middle pad ripped, run magnet wire to the L1/R1 test point.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
